# Synthetic 4625 fixtures

All events in this directory are invented test data. They contain no captured
production logs, real account names, or personal device identifiers.

The field layout follows the [Microsoft Event 4625 reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/windows/it-pro/windows-10/security/threat-protection/auditing/event-4625).
These fixtures exercise the published version-0 XML structure; they are not
proof of compatibility with every supported Windows build.

Cases include local and RDP failures, network IPv6, a machine account, missing
optional fields, reordered/unknown fields, and deliberately malformed XML.
Additional boundary cases are generated by the unit tests from these fixtures.
